name: End-of-life / unsupported software rising
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT asset_uuid) FROM vulns WHERE lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%unsupported%' OR lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%end of life%' OR lower(plugin_name) LIKE '%end-of-life%'

name: Ownerless assets rising
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(uuid) FROM assets WHERE uuid NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT asset_uuid FROM tags WHERE tag_key='Owner')

name: New CISA KEV exposure
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT asset_uuid) FROM vulns WHERE xrefs LIKE '%CISA-KNOWN-EXPLOITED%'
detail_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.hostname AS host, a.ip_address AS ip FROM vulns v LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.uuid=v.asset_uuid WHERE v.xrefs LIKE '%CISA-KNOWN-EXPLOITED%' LIMIT 100
